purpose: Decode-graph optimization campaign for Drama-3 on Ascend 910B1; RTF targets are recorded, not claimed
hypothesis: Drama-3 stage 0 samples one whole frame per stream per step, so decode is launch-bound; replaying decode as a single FULL ACL graph should cut single-stream RTF and raise frames/s without changing outputs
isolated_variable: stage-0 NPU compilation_config.cudagraph_mode: PIECEWISE vs FULL_AND_PIECEWISE
devices: 2x Ascend 910B1 (A2), stage 0 TP2 + EP on devices 0,1; DAC stage 1 on device 1
protocol: fishaudio/drama-3, streaming /v1/audio/speech, Seed-TTS-Eval en, one fixed pre-encoded reference (85 frames x 10 codebooks), max_tokens=500, 64 prompts, 1 warmup, concurrency 1..64
metrics: frames/s = audio_s x 21.5 / wall; RTF = (end - start) / audio_s including queueing and prefill; TTFA from first SSE audio event
success: C1 RTF mean improves by at least 20% with no request failures and no change to sampling semantics
stop: Stop on stage-0 readiness failure, request failures above 1 percent, or host load above twice the quiet baseline
notes: Host is shared (load average 15-20); single readings of C8-C32 are not comparable across tables. Only the FULL-graph change is in the candidate; the causal_conv1d_update binding was tested and rejected.
